items.ECN-02: US Republicans: $5,000 tariff dividend now 0.74% of GDP a year for 2027-2031 only (5-year hard cap, ignores the duration setting), from +0.8 for the duration setting. Status published (CRFB, 10 Sep 2026), not official; 'Pre-ruling figure' and 'CBO-based reporting' removed; note: conditional on GOP control; condition not met (Nov 2026), moot from Jan 2027, kept as a historical scenario. Of the review's two options (one-off 3.7% in 2027, or 0.74 x 5 capped), the second was used because 3.7 is outside the spending lever range (-3 to +3).
items.ECN-03: Coalition: spending path -0.19 / -0.27 / -0.27 / -0.29% of GDP in 2028-29 to 2031-32 (engine years 2029-2032; a financial year sits in the calendar year it ends), 0 outside; tax path 0 / 0 / -0.10 / -0.21 (net of WATO repeal; starts 2030-31), 0 after 2031-32 (outside the party costing). Levers show the averages: spending -0.25, tax -0.08 (from -0.17).
items.ECN-04: Greens new revenue +0.9% of GDP (range +0.55 gas only to +1.5), from +1.5; note: royalties figure is a state-level estimate; federal mechanism not specified.
items.ECN-05: Per-lever fixed timing (Party.sched, calendar-year paths) used for the Republican dividend and the Coalition savings and tax. Applies on the Parties tab, Mix & match and in the Simulator after 'Run <party> in the Simulator' while the lever still equals the party value. One Nation fuel excise: see ECN-05 One Nation.
items.ECN-05 One Nation: Applied 9 Nov 2026 (owner approval). Fuel excise halving -0.28% of GDP (A$8.6bn a year, range 6.0 to 13.9) in FY2027-28 to FY2029-30 only = calendar 2028 to 2030 (Party.schedPart: only this part of the lever has fixed timing). Start year: our assumption; One Nation states no start date ('Halve the fuel excise to 26 cents per liter for 3 years with a review after 12 months, with the option to extend further.'). Other tax items -0.32 follow the duration setting. Lever total stays -0.6 while the fuel cut is on, -0.32 from FY2030-31. The total is one value (ONP_TAX.total); -0.74 (sum of item estimates) awaits owner approval.
items.ECN-28: Greens preset: carbon levy PBO ECR-2025-3365 central A$17.2bn a year = +0.55% of GDP on the tax lever (A$31bn per 1%). Greens net tax lever 1.13 -> 1.08 (-0.37 + 0.9 + 0.55). Parties costing: 'Carbon price (PBO 2025, 2025 platform)' official; official tax part 0.18.
